# ContinuumApprox { #pyratfun.ContinuumApprox }

```python
ContinuumApprox(julia_obj)
```

Rational approximation on a continuum domain.

Represents a rational function approximation computed on a continuous domain
such as a curve, path, or region in the complex plane. The approximation is
constructed adaptively using methods like AAA or TCF.

Attributes:
    julia: The underlying Julia ContinuumApproximation object.
    original: The original function being approximated.
    domain: The continuum domain (curve, path, or region).
    fun: The rational function approximation (Thiele, Bary, etc.).
    allowed: Allowed pole locations.
    path: Integration path used in approximation.
    history: History of the approximation process.

## Methods

| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| [getfunction](#pyratfun.ContinuumApprox.getfunction) | Get the underlying rational function. |
| [isapprox](#pyratfun.ContinuumApprox.isapprox) | Check if this approximation is close to another function. |
| [nodes](#pyratfun.ContinuumApprox.nodes) | Get the interpolation nodes of the approximation. |
| [testpoints](#pyratfun.ContinuumApprox.testpoints) | Get the test points used to validate the approximation. |
| [values](#pyratfun.ContinuumApprox.values) | Get the function values at the interpolation nodes. |

### getfunction { #pyratfun.ContinuumApprox.getfunction }

### isapprox { #pyratfun.ContinuumApprox.isapprox }

```python

```

Args:

Returns:
